notes.title: Significantly Optimized!
notes.content:
A long, five years of mystery has been solved! The game's open area was running slow, and after a long time, I have managed to find its reason. My previous frame rate has been almost doubled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827019/8e73de3436c0aba988848c010879f20b6298b6aa.jpg[/img]

Please enjoy the game with much higher frame rates now.

notes.title: VR
notes.content:
Dear VR enthusiasts!

As you may have heard, it is now possible to run any Unreal Engine game on VR thanks to the UEVR mod.

Since my games are made with Unreal, I just tried a few of them and it was a breathtaking experience. Some of the best ones with the VR were Drizzlepath: Deja Vu, Pluviophile, and the upcoming one Run Tekila Run!.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704860/Run_Tekila_Run/

I strongly recommend trying out the mod and experiencing the ultimate immersion. Here is a download link to the mod:
https://github.com/praydog/UEVR/releases/tag/1.01

Get yourselves ready to fly into distant lands! 

Game on,
Tonguç

notes.title: Bottle
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I have recreated Bottle from 2016.

[i]Bottle is a very short game in which you play as an alcoholic man of solitude. It is about the mood of melancholy in winter nature. As you walk through the path, you see the visions of a woman and hear the poems she leaves to you.[/i]

ːbtlbottleː Check out the store page while you wishlist the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384850/Bottle/

ːbtlbottleː Here's a 4K trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HRETz1ieKcs&ab_channel=TongucBodur

I had a great time making it, and hope you'll like it.

With love and respect,
Tonguç

notes.title: March '22 Update
notes.content:
With the new update, the game's engine has been updated to 4.27.

By this version, I have implemented Nvidia DLSS support to the game. If your graphics card supports DLSS, you can enable it via the General Settings menu. It should significantly improve the performance.

Cheers!

notes.title: Loverowind
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
My next little game [i]Loverowind[/i] will be released soon!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33016994/06539a1948bab356951111f451a7d6e8e055dd03.png[/img]

It is similar to [i]Pluviophile[/i] and [i]Chionophile[/i] due to collecting flowers, using them on altars, and revealing poems.

The new thing in this one is a little more [b]gameplay[/b]. There are some little speed-boosters, some lit circles to run away from, and some giant spheres to catch in order to proceed in the game.

In summary, I've added a bit of a challenge to my traditional poetic themed game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625960/Loverowind/

The game will not take a long time to finish, similar to Pluviophile, and so it will be priced similar as well. It will be released on [b]May 19[/b]. I had so much fun making it, and hope you'll feel the same when you play it.

Please check out the store page, [b]wishlist and follow[/b] the game if you are interested.

Much love,
[i]Tonguç[/i]
